title: The Heavens Declare the Glory of God

questions.question: The heavens declare the glory of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:1 (ESV): "The heavens declare the glory of God,"

questions.question: Day to day pours out speech, and night to night reveals what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:2 (ESV): "Day to day pours out speech, and night to night reveals knowledge."

questions.question: The law of the Lord is perfect, reviving the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:7 (ESV): "The law of the Lord is perfect, reviving the soul;"

questions.question: The testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:7 (ESV): "...the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple;"

questions.question: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, O Lord, my rock and my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:14 (ESV): "...O Lord, my rock and my redeemer."

questions.question: The precepts of the Lord are right, rejoicing the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:8 (ESV): "the precepts of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart;"

questions.question: The commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:8 (ESV): "...the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes;"

questions.question: More to be desired are they than gold, even much what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:10 (ESV): "More to be desired are they than gold, even much fine gold;"

questions.question: Sweeter also than honey and drippings of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:10 (ESV): "...sweeter also than honey and drippings of the honeycomb."

questions.question: Keep back your servant also from what kind of sins?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:13 (ESV): "Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins;"

questions.question: In them he has set a tent for the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:4 (ESV): "In them he has set a tent for the sun,"

questions.question: Which comes out like a bridegroom leaving his chamber, and like a strong man runs its course with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:5 (ESV): "...and like a strong man runs its course with joy."

questions.question: Who can discern his errors? Declare me innocent from what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:12 (ESV): "Who can discern his errors? Declare me innocent from hidden faults."

questions.question: Then I shall be blameless, and innocent of great what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:13 (ESV): "Then I shall be blameless, and innocent of great transgression."

questions.question: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 19:9 (ESV): "the fear of the Lord is clean, enduring forever;"

key_verse_text: The heavens declare the glory of God, and the sky above proclaims his handiwork.
